rationale: Standard cosmological injury-doublet: ⲡⲱⲍ (= ⲡⲱϩ 'breach, wound') + Greek πληγή 'blow.' Used here of the harm that the released energies must not inflict on the body of the Youth.

proposed_english: the Wall of the Great Fire
rationale: Outermost cosmic firewall; technical Manichaean cosmography. Paired with the stronghold of Darkness (line 23) as the dual encircling barrier of the cosmos.
Triadic technical term opening this kephalaion: the teachings of the Mother, the Wind, and the Living Fire — each revealed at its own appointed season.
Greek loanword ἀλλαγή 'change, alteration' with prefixed ⲕ- (perhaps from intermediate κατ- form). Used here of the 'change of his thought' (ⲧⲕⲁⲗⲗⲁⲍⲏ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲉⲩ) — the Youth's mental transformation.
Variant spelling of ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ with final -ⲛ; could be a scribal feature of this Lycopolitan witness. Function ('the man who is mounted upon her') confirms personal-noun reading.
Lyc reflex of ⲡⲱϩ 'break, breach, wound.' Standard Coptic; useful for future occurrences in this corpus where bodily/cosmic injury is described.
Lyc ⲥⲱϩⲣ̄/ⲥⲁϩⲣⲉ 'drive, expel.' Cosmogonic verb in the Wind-teaching/Fire-teaching paradigm: drive-down + draw-forth + bind-in-stronghold.
